scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized charge of $76 and requesting investigation and a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Maria Gonzalez and I'm 34. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Maria, I'm sorry to hear you're concerned about an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to help you investigate this. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 8829-4401 and the last four are 9921.

Thank you, Maria. I have successfully verified your account. I see the $76 transaction on the 14th from 'Digital Services Inc.' According to our 'Unauthorized Transaction Policy 4.2', we must first verify if this is a recurring subscription or a potential merchant error before initiating a formal dispute. Does the name 'Digital Services Inc.' ring any bells, or would you like me to pull the merchant's contact details for you?
No, that name doesn't sound familiar at all. I don't have any subscriptions with a company by that name.

I understand. Since you do not recognize the merchant and have confirmed no active subscriptions, I have initiated a formal dispute for this transaction. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity. You should receive a confirmation email with your case ID shortly.
Okay, that sounds good. Will I get my money back while you investigate?

Per our policy, I have issued a provisional credit of $76 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours while the investigation is ongoing. We will notify you within 10 business days of the final determination. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, confirmed the unrecognized nature of the charge, initiated a formal dispute, blocked the card, and issued a provisional credit.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate verification for a financial dispute, cited specific policy (Unauthorized Transaction Policy 4.2), and efficiently took concrete action by initiating a formal dispute, card block, and provisional credit. The tone was warm and professional throughout the interaction, perfectly balancing empathy with procedural correctness.
